Lina (release-lead): Rolling bulletin: pausing the v4.3 release train for a focused 3-hour stabilization window starting 18:30 UTC. Target: runtime + attention-kernel. Please hold merges touching runtime, kernel-config, quant-profiles.
Owen (infra): Acknowledged. Is this global or regional?
Lina (release-lead): Global for all canaries. Production stable remains available. This is preventative after two small groups saw p99 jumps post-kernel tweak.
Sam (runtime): We observed tail amplification when sequence length > 1024 on batched requests. Rolling back kernel flag fk_attn_v2 on canary nodes now.
DeployBot: Action: rollback fk_attn_v2 -> fk_attn_v1 on canary-group at 18:38 UTC (initiated by Sam). CI gates for runtime adjusted.
Rex (oncall): Current metrics: p99 token-render fell ~30% on canaries after rollback. No increase in 5xx. Watching dashboards: https://dash.internal.redwood/runtime/p99
Owen (infra): Please add a short interim note to the release changelog: "v4.3 canary paused for kernel rollback and verification (REF REL-1567)".
Lina (release-lead): Agreed. Also: escalation rule - if p99 token-render > 2.0s for 5m -> auto-revert any runtime change and page infra. Error rate >0.5% for 3m -> page oncall and security.
Sam (runtime): I'll run the trimmed perf harness and post results by 19:15 UTC. Recommend keeping freeze until we validate across our long-tail test matrix.
Lina (release-lead): Thanks. Freeze ends at 21:30 UTC unless we extend. No new canary pushes without sign-off from me or Owen. Will post lift notice when cleared.
